# Derivation 3.4B — Scalar carrier and readout consistency {#sec-derivation-03-04B-scalar-carrier-readout .unnumbered}

## Purpose

This appendix derives clocks, rulers, massive motion, null motion, scalar
sourcing, and field--carrier work from one point-carrier action. The derivation
replaces the former claim that comoving-cycle reasoning by itself fixes the
physical spatial coefficient.

## Role, regime, and status

- **Role:** explicit scalar carrier realization and bounded obstruction.
- **Regime:** weak scalar response, algebraic parity-even single-shell carrier
  coupling, collisionless point carriers.
- **Status:** clock/ruler/null consistency and reciprocal point-carrier work
  are derived for the displayed action. Bound matter and interacting source
  allocation are not.
- **Non-claim:** the result is not a general theorem against every carrier or
  multisector theory, and it does not derive PPN $\gamma=1$ from content-only
  SI.

## One generator, one operational map

Let $\theta$ be dimensionless, let $t_*$ be the action evolution parameter
normalized to the asymptotic clock, and take

$$
H=N(\theta)c
\sqrt{p_f^2+Q(\theta)\,\delta^{ij}p_i p_j},
\qquad N>0,\quad Q>0,
\tag{3.4B.1}
$$

with $N(0)=Q(0)=1$. A compatible point-carrier plus scalar-field action is

$$
S_\theta=\frac Z2\int dt_*d^3x
\left(\frac{\dot\theta^2}{c^2}-|\nabla\theta|^2\right),
$$

$$
S_c=\sum_a\int dt_*
\left[p_{ai}\dot x_a^i-H_a\right].
\tag{3.4B.2}
$$

For a static carrier, Equation (3.4B.1) multiplies every rest-cycle frequency
by $N$. The local clock is therefore

$$
d\tau=N\,dt_*.
\tag{3.4B.3}
$$

Dividing the energy by this clock factor gives the local shell

$$
H_{\mathrm{local}}=c\sqrt{p_f^2+Qp^2}.
$$

Hence the orthonormal local momentum is $\hat p_i=\sqrt{Q}\,p_i$. Canonical
duality, $p_i dx^i=\hat p_i d\ell^i$, fixes the ruler:

$$
d\ell^i=\frac{dx^i}{\sqrt Q},
\qquad
d\ell^2=Q^{-1}\delta_{ij}dx^i dx^j.
\tag{3.4B.4}
$$

The ruler is derived from the same generator as the clock. It is not appended
as a metric factor after the carrier dynamics have been chosen.

## Massive and massless transport

Hamilton's equation gives

$$
\dot x^i=NcQ\frac{p^i}{M_Q},
\qquad
M_Q:=\sqrt{p_f^2+Qp^2}.
\tag{3.4B.5}
$$

Combining Equations (3.4B.3)--(3.4B.5),

$$
v_{\mathrm{local}}^i:=\frac{d\ell^i}{d\tau}
=c\sqrt Q\frac{p^i}{M_Q}.
$$

For $p_f\neq0$, $|\mathbf v_{\mathrm{local}}|<c$. For a massless carrier,
$p_f=0$, the coordinate and local speeds are

$$
\frac{|d\mathbf x|}{dt_*}=cN\sqrt Q,
\qquad
\boxed{\frac{d\ell}{d\tau}=c}.
\tag{3.4B.6}
$$

The equality is exact for every positive $N,Q$ and uses the clock and ruler
derived from the same action.

## Newtonian and weak spatial slopes

Write

$$
N=1-\alpha\theta+O(\theta^2),
\qquad
Q=1-2\alpha\gamma\theta+O(\theta^2),
\qquad \alpha>0,
\tag{3.4B.7}
$$

and define

$$
U:=-\alpha c^2\theta.
\tag{3.4B.8}
$$

The slow massive equation becomes $\ddot{\mathbf x}=-\nabla U$. The clock and
ruler read

$$
d\tau=\left(1+\frac U{c^2}\right)dt_*+\cdots,
$$

$$
d\ell^2=
\left(1-2\gamma\frac U{c^2}\right)
\delta_{ij}dx^i dx^j+\cdots.
\tag{3.4B.9}
$$

Thus $\gamma$ is the weak isotropic spatial coefficient. The null coordinate
speed is

$$
v_{\mathrm{coord}}
=c\left[1+(1+\gamma)\frac U{c^2}+\cdots\right].
$$

The leading bending and Shapiro coefficients are proportional to
$1+\gamma$. Their observed weak-field values require $\gamma=1$ as a
correspondence target.

In the normalized weak clock convention used by the stationary
correspondence appendices, $\alpha=1$. In that convention the spatial
coefficient denoted $\sigma$ in Derivation 3.6C is the same coefficient:
$\sigma=\gamma$. The two symbols are retained only to distinguish the
single-shell carrier role from the boosted-metric correspondence role.

## Variation and source identity

Variation of Equation (3.4B.1) gives

$$
\Box\theta
=-\frac cZ
\left[
N'\mathcal M_Q+\frac{NQ'}2\mathcal C_{Q,kk}
\right],
\tag{3.4B.10}
$$

where

$$
\mathcal M_Q
=\left\langle\sum_aM_{Q,a}\right\rangle_x,
\qquad
\mathcal C_{Q,ij}
=\left\langle\sum_a\frac{p_{i,a}p_{j,a}}{M_{Q,a}}
\right\rangle_x.
$$

Repeated $k$ in $\mathcal C_{Q,kk}$ denotes the summed spatial trace.

At the weak flat point,

$$
\Box\theta
=\frac{\alpha c}{Z}
\left(\mathcal M+\gamma\mathcal C_{kk}\right).
$$

Cold Newtonian normalization fixes

$$
Z=\frac{\alpha^2c^4}{4\pi G_N}>0,
$$

so

$$
\boxed{
\Box\theta
=\frac{4\pi G_N}{\alpha c^3}
\left(\mathcal M+\gamma\mathcal C_{kk}\right)}.
\tag{3.4B.11}
$$

The same coefficient $\gamma$ therefore controls the weak ruler response and
the stress-trace scalar source.

This equality is not special to the $N,Q$ notation. For the diagonal
quadratic single-shell class

$$
H=c\sqrt{A(\theta)^2p_f^2+B(\theta)^2p^2},
$$

the clock is $A$, exact local $c$ fixes the ruler to $A/B$, and the weak ruler
slope fixes

$$
-\frac1c\frac{\partial H}{\partial\theta}
=\alpha\left(M+\gamma\frac{p^2}{M}\right).
\tag{3.4B.12}
$$

Equation (3.4B.12) is the single-shell source/readout identity. Its assumptions
exclude derivative worldline couplings, spin, internal multipoles,
nonquadratic shells, auxiliary constraints, and independent response fields.

## Branches and work

| Branch | Scalar source | Local $c$ | Weak light result | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $\gamma=0$ | $\mathcal M$ | exact | half the $\gamma=1$ bending and Shapiro coefficients | content-only, but not the physical overlap |
| $\gamma=1$ | $\mathcal M+\mathcal C_{kk}$ | exact | standard leading coefficients | coherent reciprocal point-carrier source redirect; not adopted or interaction-closed |

The scalar field has positive energy because $Z>0$. Multiplying the field
equation by $Z\dot\theta$ gives the field power

$$
\Xi(\mathbf x)
:=\sum_a
\frac{\partial H_a}{\partial\theta}
\delta^{(3)}(\mathbf x-\mathbf x_a).
$$

With this local definition and the declared stage time $t_*$, the reciprocal
work ledger is

$$
\partial_{t_*}u_\theta+\nabla\cdot\mathbf S_\theta
=-\Xi\dot\theta,
$$

while the explicit field dependence of the carrier Hamiltonian gives
$+\Xi\dot\theta$. The two terms cancel with the same $N'$ and $Q'$
coefficients. Deleting only the stress term would therefore break reciprocal
work.

## Result

The displayed action supplies a consistent point-carrier clock, ruler,
massive/null transport map, exact local $c$, positive scalar mode, and
reciprocal work ledger. In this single-shell class, however, a nonzero
$\gamma$ ruler and the $\gamma\mathcal C_{kk}$ scalar source are the same
coupling viewed from opposite sides. Content-only sourcing and the standard
$\gamma=1$ weak-light response are not jointly realized here.
